text:
Pakistan: footage shows a TTP sniper targeting soldiers at a Pakistani Army base in Kulachi, Dera Ismail Khan.

The militant appears to have used a Romanian made PSL designated marksman rifle.

Three more F16V Block 70 fighters have reached Taiwan's Chihhang Air Base after flying from the United States via Hawaii and Guam between November 5 and 8.

They are part of the second batch for Taiwan's air force, bringing deliveries to 5 of the 66 jets ordered.
White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt says she has spoken with President Trump several times since Tuesday's midterm results and he is "calm, cool and collected" about them.
Europe will join next week's Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi, French Foreign Minister Jean Noël Barrot says.
🚨 The aircraft carrier USS Theodore Roosevelt has left Singapore after a three day port visit and is now sailing through the Strait of Malacca toward the Middle East.

Stephen Miller plans to keep pushing a hard line immigration agenda as President Trump's new White House chief of staff, despite heavy Republican losses in the midterms, The New York Times reports.

He is expected to seek broader executive authority.

Sudan's war is heating up on two fronts.

The army claims gains in Kordofan, threatening RSF supply lines from Darfur, while the RSF claims advances in Blue Nile near Damazin.

Army chief al Burhan has rejected US ceasefire proposals. The UN says 15.4 million need shelter.
🚨 Two trains collided in the Al Ayat area of Giza, Egypt, leaving one overturned and around 120 people injured, according to Egyptian Railways.
Another US Air Force E11A early warning aircraft is heading from Ramstein in Germany to US Central Command in the Middle East.

Update: Sentinel 2 satellite imagery shows the oil tanker northwest of Khasab still ablaze, with huge smoke plumes rising.

The ship was reportedly hit by an IRGC strike today while using the US designated southern route through the Strait of Hormuz, even as CENTCOM insists the

Turkish President Erdogan on ties with Azerbaijan: those trying to weaken the brotherhood between the two nations "will never achieve their ambitions," failing today and tomorrow just as they failed yesterday.

🚨 UKMTO warning 200/26: a tanker was struck by an unknown projectile while sailing outbound through the Strait of Hormuz at 2020 UTC on 7 November.

In a time late report, the company security officer says all crew are safe and accounted for, with no environmental impact reported.

UKMTO urges vessels to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity while authorities investigate.

🚨 Iran's IRGC has released footage it says shows the explosion of a third oil tanker in the Strait of Hormuz.

The video has not been independently verified.

🚨 EXCLUSIVE | BREAKING

Iran reportedly hit overnight by the U.S. and Israel as Qatar urges the IRGC not to retaliate.

U.S. forces allegedly launched over six strikes on Qeshm Island, Hormozgan, and Bandar Abbas, completely destroying a new radar system.

Israel reportedly carried out a cyberattack that sparked a fire at an energy facility in Tehran.

Sources in Israel and two inside Iran confirmed these claims to us. Independent verification is pending.

Ukrainian forces describe North Korean soldiers as tough opponents.

Unlike Russian conscripts, they reportedly refuse to surrender, taking their own lives before capture, fight fanatically in groups and are relatively well trained.
🚨 JUST IN: 3 soldiers killed and at least 16 injured in a drone attack on a military base in northern Colombia.

🚨 Iraq issues arrest warrant for the son of the Kataib Hezbollah chief.

An Iraqi court accuses Al Hussein al Hamidawi of leading an armed militia that commits violence and threats, undermines state security and endangers civilians.
Gulf stock markets slipped on Sunday as traders held back, waiting to see President Trump's next move on Iran.

🚨 BREAKING: Iran's IRGC says it is closely monitoring the U.S. "Scorpion Strike" drone unit and claims it disrupted its operations.

Tehran warned that more drones, or launches from different locations, will not stop Iran from targeting them.

🚨 UKMTO reports a tanker on fire about 8 nautical miles northwest of Khasab, Oman, in the Strait of Hormuz.

In a time late warning (199/26), military authorities say the blaze broke out on 7 November and the crew has been evacuated.
